display_name: Teach AI Tab 9 Prompt Authoring Guide
explainer: Teaches an AI the complete Tab 9 prompt-library logic for creating or updating prompts.
how_it_works: The guide explains folder placement, metadata, group boxes, prompt structure, safety boundaries, and delivery rules.
risks: An AI may try to edit code when only prompt-library text assets are requested.
mitigations: The guide explicitly states that text-only prompt-library tasks must not change source code or active governance.
safe_usage: Copy this guide when asking an AI to create or update prompts for Tab 9.
example_usage: Open the Teach AI Prompt Authoring group and copy this guide before requesting a new prompt-library asset.
